title: Account & Security Policy
content:
Account & Security Policy

1. Account Security:
   - Always keep your password confidential and enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) in settings.
   - We will never ask for your account password or OTP via call, SMS, or chat.

2. Suspicious Activity & Fraud:
   - If you notice unauthorized orders or unexpected password reset emails, report them immediately.
   - Fraudulent transactions or unauthorized access will be escalated to our Security & Fraud team for account protection.

title: Cancellation Policy
content:
Cancellation Policy

1. Pre-Dispatch Cancellation:
   - Orders can be cancelled instantly before dispatch via the app/website or through our support assistant.
   - Full 100% refund is initiated automatically upon cancellation.

2. Post-Dispatch Cancellation:
   - If the item has already been shipped, it cannot be cancelled in-transit.
   - Customers may refuse delivery at the doorstep or accept and initiate a 30-day return.

3. Automated Cancellation:
   - Orders may be cancelled by the system due to stock unavailability or address verification issues.
   - Full refund is processed immediately if pre-paid.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q: How can I track my order?
A: You can track your order using the tracking ID provided in your order confirmation email or order details page. Enter the tracking ID on our courier partner's portal or ask our agent for real-time status.

Q: How long does shipping take?
A: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Delivery times may vary for remote or rural locations.

Q: Can I cancel my order?
A: Yes, orders can be cancelled anytime before they are dispatched. Once shipped, you must initiate a return after delivery.

Q: How can I contact customer support?
A: Support is available 24/7 via AI Live Chat, email at support@example.com, or toll-free call at 1800-123-4567 (9 AM - 9 PM IST).

Q: What payment methods are accepted?
A: We accept Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay, Amex), UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Net Banking, EMI, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible items.

Q: How do refunds work?
A: Refunds are processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days after the returned product passes quality inspection.

Q: How do I update my shipping address?
A: You can update your shipping address from your account settings before the order is packed. If already shipped, contact support immediately.

title: Payment Policy and Issue Resolution
content:
Payment Policy and Issue Resolution

1. Accepted Payment Methods:
   - Credit & Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Maestro)
   - UPI Payment (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM)
   - Net Banking across 50+ major banks
   - EMI Options on select credit cards
   - Cash on Delivery (COD) up to Rs. 10,000

2. Failed Transactions & Double Charges:
   - If payment is deducted but order fails, amount is auto-refunded by bank within 2-5 business days.
   - For duplicate payments on the same order, report to support for priority verification and immediate reversal.

3. Invoices & Receipts:
   - GST invoices can be downloaded directly from the order history page.

title: Refund and Return Policy
content:
Refund and Return Policy

1. Return Window:
   - Products can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
   - Items must be unused, in original packaging, with intact tags and seal.

2. Non-Returnable Items:
   - Software licenses, digital downloads, hygiene items, and customized products are non-returnable unless damaged upon delivery.

3. Refund Processing Timelines:
   - Credit / Debit Cards: 5 to 7 business days after return verification.
   - UPI / Net Banking: 2 to 4 business days after return verification.
   - Cash on Delivery (COD): Refunded to verified bank account / UPI ID within 3-5 days after account details are provided.

4. Return Shipping Fee:
   - Free pick-up for defective, damaged, or incorrect items.
   - A nominal return fee of Rs. 100 applies for standard preference returns.

5. How to Initiate a Return:
   - Request a return via customer support or account portal under 'My Orders'.

title: Shipping and Delivery Policy
content:
Shipping and Delivery Policy

1. Delivery Timelines:
   - Standard Delivery: 3 to 5 business days across major cities.
   - Express Shipping: 1 to 2 business days (available at checkout for select PIN codes).
   - Remote Locations: 5 to 7 business days.

2. Shipping Charges:
   - Orders above Rs. 499 qualify for FREE standard shipping.
   - Orders below Rs. 499 incur a flat Rs. 50 shipping fee.
   - Express shipping is charged at Rs. 150 per order.

3. Order Tracking:
   - Once dispatched, a tracking ID (e.g. TRK10001) and courier link are shared via SMS/Email.
   - You can inquire about order status anytime by providing your Order ID (e.g. ORD1001).

4. Undelivered / Delayed Packages:
   - Couriers attempt delivery up to 3 times before returning the parcel to origin.
   - If delivery is delayed beyond 7 business days, support can file an investigation ticket with the logistics partner.

title: Warranty and Repair Policy
content:
Warranty and Repair Policy

1. Standard Warranty Coverage:
   - All electronic products carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty from the date of invoice.
   - Warranty covers manufacturing defects, hardware failures, and component malfunctions under normal usage.

2. Warranty Exclusions:
   - Physical damage, liquid spills, unauthorized repairs, or burn marks are excluded from warranty coverage.

3. Claim Process:
   - Provide invoice copy and product serial number.
   - Support generates a pickup label for diagnostic evaluation at an authorized service center.
   - Repair or replacement is completed within 7 to 10 business days.
